content:
ana: Heads-up — I uploaded the gptx-7b_v2 shard bundle and manifest to the registry. Need a quick sanity/access check before we flip the onboarding pipeline.

ana: Manifest path: s3://rw-artifacts/weights/gptx-7b_v2/manifest.json
ana: HF origin: https://huggingface.co/rw-models/gptx-7b-v2
ana: Note: tokenizer.json had an extra 'bos_token' key on the HF copy; I normalized locally (removed duplicate entry).

mike: On it. Are we doing a full mirror or leaving HF as upstream with presigned fallback?
mike: Also need IAM check — who has read access to the s3 prefix?

ana: Plan is mirror-first for production; fallback to HF only for small dev batches. For mirroring we use rw-artifacts bucket with lifecycle rules.

tara: I'll validate the manifest schema quickly. Can you paste the top-level fields?

ana: Top-level: {"model_name": "gptx-7b_v2", "shards": 32, "format": "safetensors", "checksums": "checksums-v2.sha256", "tokenizer": "tokenizer.json"}  <-- short copy/paste

mike: Running checksum spot-check on a couple random shards now. Command I used locally:
```
sha256sum shard-00012.safetensors
# expected from checksums-v2.sha256
```

mike: Results: shard-00012 -> 3a7f1c4b9e... (matches)

mike: shard-00007 -> mismatch: local 8b2d... vs manifest 6b2f...

ana: Ugh. I rebuilt shard 7 earlier this morning after a tokenization fix. Maybe the manifest wasn't updated.

tara: If manifest vs actual differ we should tag the manifest as staging and not promote. Can you re-gen manifest and push? Also update the checksum filename in the manifest field if changed.

ana: Will regenerate and upload new manifest+checksums in ~10m. I'll keep the object key the same but add metadata x-rw-build: 2026-03-?? to track.

sanjay: Quick note on access: current bucket policy allows read for role arn:aws:iam::111222:role/rw-artifacts-reader and our CI service. If you need cross-account access (partner infra) open a ticket with security.

sanjay: Also presign TTL default is 1h from the mirroring job; we can change per-job if needed.

artifact-bot: Mirror job #4532 finished: copied 31/32 shards to s3://rw-artifacts/weights/gptx-7b_v2/ (shard-00007 skipped due to checksum mismatch). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/4532/logs

mike: Nice — that explains mismatch. artifact-bot saved the partial state.

ana: New manifest and checksums uploaded: s3://rw-artifacts/weights/gptx-7b_v2/manifest-20260307.json and checksums-20260307.sha256

tara: Quick schema validation result: manifest-20260307.json passes schema v1.4 — shards listed = 32, format=safetensors, tokenizer present.

tara: One small comment left in the PR: the tokenizer's 'add_prefix_space' is true in HF copy but false in our tokenizer.json; tests pass but flag mismatch is worth noting in the release notes.

ana: Good catch. I ran inference smoke locally, seems fine but I'll add a short test to the onboarding pipeline to assert tokenizer flags match the validated tokenizer.json.

mike: Access sanity: I could fetch all objects with the reader role using the presign endpoint. Presigned URLs expire in 1h by default — I generated one for checkpoint-00012 and it downloads fine.

mike: Suggestion: set presign TTL to 15m for production mirroring jobs and 1h for dev mirrors. Keeps blast radius small. :thumbsup:

sanjay: Agree. I can add TTL override to the mirroring job config — PR incoming.

ana: Thanks all. Next steps: I will update PR with tokenizer flag note + add the assert test. Tara — can you approve manifest PR once the tokenizer note is in?

tara: Yep, I'll watch the PR. Ping me when pushed.

mike: Leaving a small note: add CI step to fail onboarding if any shard missing or checksum mismatch — don't rely on artifact-bot partial success. Filed #789 to track.

ana: Filing follow-up ticket for release notes and onboarding test. Thanks! :rocket:
